integrity.proof_scope: Exact finite identity and an analytic large-order limit; exhaustive computation only checks finite examples.

scientific_limitations: The conditioning singles out a predesignated isolated vertex, not the event of at least one isolated vertex.
The total-variation estimate is an upper bound, not an optimality statement.
Original 1988 paper could not be fully inspected; historical priority remains qualified.
title: Isolation-conditioned splitting and a persistent edge covariance in uniform random interval graphs
